engineeringSkip.reason: Neutron-degenerate matter is only held together by a neutron star's own gravity, and there is no known mechanism to 'stabilise' it with the strong force, so this is speculation with no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Neutronium only exists crushed inside neutron stars; nothing can stabilise a shell of it in open space, and the strong nuclear force cannot be 'manipulated' to hold it together, so the idea contradicts established physics.
